description: Easily generate and modify .docx files with JS/TS with a nice declarative API. Works for Node and on the Browser.

latest_release.body:
9.16.0 adds `autoSpaceLatinAndEastAsianText`, a paragraph option for the small space Word puts between East Asian text and a Latin letter beside it (`w:autoSpaceDE`), so Korean text such as "docx로" can be written without the gap. It and `autoSpaceEastAsianText` can now be set in paragraph styles, numbering levels and the document defaults as well as on a paragraph, and docx writes paragraph properties in the order the schema gives them. On the fixes side, `estimatePageNumbers` from `docx/layout` now lays out three things in report templates that used to stop it, as Word lays them out: a table row that repeats its table's properties (`w:tblPrEx`), a line at multiple line spacing at the foot of a table row that breaks across pages, and a fixed-size text box with more text than fits in it (#3912). The README's Node examples now point at the demos in `demo/` rather than RunKit.

## What's Changed
* docs: point the README's Node examples at demo/ instead of RunKit by @fstandhartinger in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3906
* feat: add autoSpaceLatinAndEastAsianText for the space beside Latin letters by @yschoi9733 in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3916
* build(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.3.7 to 8.3.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3907
* build(deps-dev): bump inquirer from 14.2.5 to 14.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3908
* build(deps-dev): bump jsdom from 31.0.0 to 31.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3909
* build(deps-dev): bump glob from 14.0.4 to 14.0.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3910
* build(deps-dev): bump prettier from 3.9.10 to 3.10.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3911
* build(deps-dev): bump eslint-plugin-jsdoc from 65.4.5 to 65.4.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3913
* build(deps-dev): bump eslint from 10.14.0 to 10.15.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3915
* build(deps-dev): bump cspell from 10.4.1 to 10.5.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3917
* fix(layout): lay out rows that repeat their table's properties, split rows at multiple line spacing and overfull text boxes, as Word does by @dolanmiu in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3918
* chore: Version bump to 9.16.0 by @dolanmiu in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3919

## New Contributors
* @fstandhartinger made their first contribution in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3906
* @yschoi9733 made their first contribution in https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/pull/3916

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/compare/9.15.4...9.16.0

--- [![NPM version][npm-image]][npm-url] [![Downloads per month][downloads-image]][downloads-url] [![GitHub Action Workflow Status][github-actions-workflow-image]][github-actions-workflow-url] [![Known Vulnerabilities][snky-image]][snky-url] [![PRs Welcome][pr-image]][pr-url] [![codecov][codecov-image]][codecov-url] [![Docx.js Editor][docxjs-editor-image]][docxjs-editor-url]

# Demo ## Browser With basic `HTML/JS` in a browser, load `docx`'s browser build, which defines a global `docx`: ```html ``` Here are examples of `docx` working in `Angular`: - https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-docx - https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-wmd6k3 Here are examples of `docx` working in `React`: - https://stackblitz.com/edit/react-docx - https://stackblitz.com/edit/react-docx-images (adding images to Word Document) Here is an example of `docx` working in `Vue.js`: - https://stackblitz.com/edit/vuejs-docx ## Node Runnable examples live in [`demo/`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/tree/master/demo), grouped by topic. In a clone of this repository, after `npm install` and `npm run build`, run one with `npm run run-ts -- ./demo//.ts`; it writes `My Document.docx` to the root of the repository. - [`demo/getting-started/basic-document.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/getting-started/basic-document.ts) - Simple paragraph and text - [`demo/styles/default-styles.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/styles/default-styles.ts) - Advanced paragraphs and text - [`demo/lists/numbering-and-bullet-points.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/lists/numbering-and-bullet-points.ts) - Bullet points and numbering - [`demo/tables/basic-table.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/tables/basic-table.ts) - Simple table - [`demo/images/images.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/images/images.ts) - Images - [`demo/page-layout/page-borders.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/page-layout/page-borders.ts) - Margins - [`demo/page-layout/landscape.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/page-layout/landscape.ts) - Landscape - [`demo/headers-and-footers/header-and-footer.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/headers-and-footers/header-and-footer.ts) - Header and Footer - [`demo/getting-started/cv.ts`](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/blob/master/demo/getting-started/cv.ts) - **My CV generated with docx** # How to use & Documentation Please refer to the [documentation at https://docx.js.org/](https://docx.js.org/) for details on how to use this library, examples and much more! # Shapes, watermarks and charts Shapes, groups of shapes and diagrams with connectors come with `docx`, from `docx/shapes`, watermarks from `docx/watermarks`, and native Word charts from `docx/charts`. They are left out of `docx` itself, so documents that don't use them don't carry their code: ```ts import { Document, Header, Paragraph } from "docx"; import { ChartRun } from "docx/charts"; import { ShapeRun } from "docx/shapes"; import { TextWatermark } from "docx/watermarks"; const doc = new Document({ sections: [ { headers: { default: new Header({ children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextWatermark({ text: "DRAFT" })] })] }) }, children: [ new Paragraph({ children: [new ShapeRun({ type: "ellipse", transformation: { width: 100, height: 60 } })] }), new Paragraph({ children: [new ChartRun({ type: "column", categories: ["Q1", "Q2"], series: [{ name: "Sales", values: [10, 20] }] })], }), ], }, ], }); ``` In a page without a bundler, load `dist/shapes.umd.cjs`, `dist/watermarks.umd.cjs` or `dist/charts.umd.cjs` after `dist/index.umd.cjs`. They add the `docxShapes`, `docxWatermarks` and `docxCharts` globals. See the [shapes](https://docx.js.org/#/usage/shapes), [watermarks](https://docx.js.org/#/usage/watermarks) and [charts](https://docx.js.org/#/usage/charts) documentation. # HTML HTML, such as what people write in a rich-text editor, becomes a document's paragraphs, lists, tables, images, links, equations and footnotes with `docx/html`, written in the document's own styles: ```ts import { Document } from "docx"; import { htmlToContent } from "docx/html"; const doc = new Document({ sections: [{ children: htmlToContent("

Report

Sales were up 12%.

  • EMEA
  • APAC
") }], }); ``` In a page without a bundler, load `dist/html.umd.cjs` after `dist/index.umd.cjs` and `dist/math.umd.cjs`. It adds the `docxHtml` global. See the [HTML](https://docx.js.org/#/usage/html) documentation. # Macros VBA macros, written from their code, make a document a macro-enabled document (`.docm`), with `docx/macros`: ```ts import { Document, Paragraph } from "docx"; import { createMacros } from "docx/macros"; const doc = new Document({ macros: createMacros({ modules: [{ name: "Greetings", code: 'Sub SayHello()\n MsgBox "Hello"\nEnd Sub' }], }), sections: [{ children: [new Paragraph("Run SayHello from View > Macros")] }], }); ``` In a page without a bundler, load `dist/macros.umd.cjs` after `dist/index.umd.cjs`. It adds the `docxMacros` global. See the [macros](https://docx.js.org/#/usage/macros) documentation. # Embedded Files Workbooks, documents, presentations and any other file, such as a sound, a video or a PDF, are embedded in a document as OLE objects, which open from it, with `docx/embedded-files`: ```ts import * as fs from "fs"; import { Document, Paragraph } from "docx"; import { EmbeddedFileRun } from "docx/embedded-files"; const doc = new Document({ sections: [ { children: [ new Paragraph({ children: [ new EmbeddedFileRun({ fileName: "budget.xlsx", data: fs.readFileSync("./budget.xlsx"), preview: { type: "png", data: fs.readFileSync("./budget.png") }, transformation: { width: 240, height: 120 }, }), ], }), ], }, ], }); ``` In a page without a bundler, load `dist/embedded-files.umd.cjs` after `dist/index.umd.cjs`. It adds the `docxEmbeddedFiles` global. See the [embedded files](https://docx.js.org/#/usage/embedded-files) documentation. # Citations and Bibliography Sources, citations of them in the text and a bibliography, in one of Word's styles of citation, such as APA, MLA or Chicago, written as Word writes them, with `docx/bibliography`: ```ts import { Document, Paragraph, TextRun } from "docx"; import { Bibliography, Citation, CitationStyle, SourceType, createBibliography } from "docx/bibliography"; const doc = new Document({ bibliography: createBibliography({ style: CitationStyle.APA, sources: [ { tag: "Bak10", type: SourceType.BOOK, authors: [{ lastName: "Baker", firstName: "Anna" }], title: "The Art of Pizza", year: 2010, city: "Naples", publisher: "Oven Press", }, ], }), sections: [ { children: [ new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("Pizza has been baked in Naples for centuries "), new Citation("Bak10")] }), new Bibliography({ title: "References" }), ], }, ], }); ``` In a page without a bundler, load `dist/bibliography.umd.cjs` after `dist/index.umd.cjs`. It adds the `docxBibliography` global. See the [citations and bibliography](https://docx.js.org/#/usage/bibliography) documentation. # Playground Experience `docx` in action through [Docx.js Editor][docxjs-editor-url], an interactive playground where you can code and preview the results in real-time. # Examples Check the [demo folder](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx/tree/master/demo) for examples. # Contributing Read the contribution guidelines [here](https://docx.js.org/#/contribution-guidelines). # Used by [](https://hfour.com/) [](https://fuzzproductions.com/) [](https://www.mettzer.com/) [](https://www.wisedoc.net/) [](https://www.dabblewriter.com/) [](https://turbopatent.com/) [](http://www.madisoncres.com/) [](https://www.beekast.com/) [](https://herraizsoto.com/) [](http://www.ativer.com.br/) [](https://www.arity.co/) [](https://www.circadianrisk.com/) [](https://lexense.com/) [](https://novelpad.co/) [](https://proton.me/) ...and many more!
